material.description: scenarios/moba/slot-models.tsv assigns: creep->character-skeleton, creep_ranged->character-archer, creep_siege->character-orc, creep_super and creep_mega->character-zombie, creep_ranged_super and creep_ranged_mega->character-ghost, creep_siege_super and creep_siege_mega->character-vampire, plus tender->character-female-a and courier->character-human. Every creep row's previous_model is character-skeleton, so these were stand-ins, never a choice. Sourced so far: the melee lane creep is the stock Footman and the super melee creep is the Ghoul (read from the reference map's unit data). Ranged, siege and the mega variants are unresolved. Blocking fact: these need generated models, and quota is prioritised to the 57 heroes. Witness: slot-models.tsv against the models directory.

notes.note: hy3d reports 6 of 7 units repointed to generated models and pushed (courier, creep_mega, creep_siege_super/mega, creep_ranged_super/mega; ghost is static, accepted). tender remains on character-female-a; its chain failed at the first stage with fetch failed and was restarted. Close when tender is repointed and witnessed on origin.

material.subject: 11 units draw a generic character-* placeholder instead of their own model
material.witness: origin/main 4162763f: no .osd file under scenarios/moba references a character-* placeholder (git show origin/main per file, count 0); tender-skinned.glb present; units.osd lists tender on tender-skinned. Witness dispatch is a git_show of origin/main from session verify-content-units-on-placeholder-models.
